decision_gate.keep_if: Diagnostic dev result improves the relevant metric without invalidating full causal tracking; then train a matched-budget policy repair.
decision_gate.reject_if: No improvement or severe drift; do not promote runtime bias and keep architecture unchanged.
decision_gate.next: Only after dev diagnosis, train one policy-only repair on all 882 trajectories; then freeze on dev and run all three tests.

scope: Diagnostics only; fixed checkpoint and unchanged architecture/modules; outputs cannot be reported as final test results.
